analyst_view.overall: Early view: Erzurumspor (12th) host Kocaelispor (7th) in an early Sunday kick-off. Serkan Ozbalta's promoted side have scored ten in eleven and lost their last two before the break, while Selcuk Inan's Kocaelispor have one of the league's best defences, with nine goals conceded. Both have two more league games first, so form may have moved by then.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.0 goals, already low, and I agree with it. Kocaelispor's games have averaged two goals and Erzurumspor score less than a goal a game, so I see a tight, low-scoring match.

corners.text: The numbers say 7.9 corners. Neither side builds much pressure in the final third, so a low count fits.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards. No suspensions or rivalries are reported, so I stay near the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.9 shots and I lean slightly lower. Kocaelispor allow opponents very little (nine goals conceded all season) and Erzurumspor have created little lately, scoring once in each of their last two games.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.2 shots on target. That already reflects two careful sides, so I stay with it.
